## Trip overview   At a glance

Fourteen days across three countries: Panama City, its canal and an Emberá village, then Boquete, Barú Volcano and the islands of the Gulf of Chiriquí; Costa Rica’s Manuel Antonio, the crocodiles of the Tárcoles, the Monteverde cloud forest, Arenal and the Caño Negro wetlands; and finally colonial Granada, Masaya Volcano and the Isletas of Lake Nicaragua.
